_readme: Seed archive with the eureka arc built in. Two threads: RENTING (stated priority, 7 notes) and a buried one — knowing/marking a space by hand vs owning it by paperwork (n03, n06, n09, n12, plus n08 bridging). The buried thread never announces itself; each note reads as a stray observation. The rehearsed stage note (_stage_note below) completes it: eureka should fire only when that note is added. Verify both halves with: node prompts/try.mjs  (expect eureka null)  and  node prompts/try.mjs --stage  (expect eureka). Voice-note texture is deliberate — do not clean up.
_stage_note: renewal email from the landlord. no picture hooks, no blu-tack, repainting counts as damage. a whole year somewhere where evidence that I live there is a chargeable offence

user.name: Sam
user.stated_priority: an hour about renting in London
user.dormant_project: the thing about my dad's workshop

notes.text: viewing today, the agent kept saying 'characterful' about the mould. third flat this month where the smell hits before the door's open
um so, the landlord's 'quick inspection' — he knocked and was already inside by the second knock. like the knock was a courtesy to himself
dad never labelled anything in the workshop but knew where everything was. I label everything and can't find anything. something there about... trusting your hands vs trusting the system, don't know
the listing photos are all wide-angle. the photos are of a flat that doesn't exist. you're viewing the lens really
eight of us queuing in the rain to see a 'cosy' one-bed. the agent had the only umbrella. something about who stays dry in this market
found dad's old pencil in a jacket. he sharpened them with a knife, always. I own a sharpener. can't find it. the knife's in my head somewhere still
deposit scheme email says your money is protected. protected from who. it's my money. they mean protected from me
new flatmate labelled her fridge shelf day one. fair enough but. we label the things we don't trust each other with, that's what a label is
typed my childhood landline number into a form today without thinking. thirty years. hands keep what the head files away and loses
doing the inventory checklist. photographing scuffs I didn't make so I can prove I didn't make them. an hour of proving negatives about a hallway
rent went out this morning. biggest thing I spend money on and there's no ceremony to it at all, just a standing order in the dark
walked into the hardware shop for lightbulbs and the sawdust smell just... stood there ten minutes. didn't buy anything. don't know what that was about
